_readme: The release queue for content/_scheduled-*. scripts/release-scheduled.mjs reads it.
Each entry: the scheduled file's slug, the directory under content/ it ships to,
the US Eastern date it ships, and the hub group it is listed under on the
exotic-pet-legal-hub article. hubGroup is needed only for pages with no matrix
animal id (group pages); species pages derive it from legalGroups.js.
inbound lists edits to live articles that should carry a link to the page
from the day it goes live: a file, an exact sentence to find, and its
replacement. Pages that link each other must share a day or the target
ships first; the order below respects that, so change dates in pairs.
